'''Lalande''' was a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] who served in the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Lalande was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the militia and worked as an aide to [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Xirossk]]. After the [[Battle of Soboll]], she met with the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to thank them for helping to bring about the militia victory.
